# Extended Parameter Ablations and Operational Details {#sec-app-operational}



This appendix provides the complete empirical ablation tables referenced in the main text, covering the `nsa_flow` trade-off weight $w \in [0.01, 0.95]$, in-fold subject row-mean removal and deterministic ICA initialization, fine-grained quantile sparsity $q \in [\text{None}, 0.90]$, the 1,025-configuration `ADNI-MCI` grid sweep, synthetic per-regime breakdowns, and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests against `PCA`, followed by computational complexity bounds.

## Effect of the Approximate Stiefel Weight $w \in [0.01, 0.95]$

@tbl-app-w-sweep and @fig-w-sweep evaluate `SiMLR` ($\mathbf{V}_m \ge 0, k = 3$) across ten values of $w \in [0.01, 0.95]$ on synthetic `NonnegParts` and clinical `ADNI-MCI` (`Protocol B`). ### Basis Health and Rank-Selection Stability Diagnostics on `ADNI-MCI`

To verify optimization conditioning and component identifiability directly on the four-view `ADNI-MCI` cohort (`Protocol B`), @fig-adni-basis-diagnostics applies `pysimlr.plot_basis_diagnostics` ($k = 3$, $q = 0.85$), reporting per-view effective rank against $k$, maximum column cosine overlap, $\log_{10}$ condition number, and achieved sparsity alongside the median `loading_margin`. @fig-adni-rank-selection applies `pysimlr.plot_rank_selection` (`criterion="latent_reliability"`, @sec-stability-bagging-sem and @eq-oob-icc1) to the 20-subsample `select_rank` evidence (`docs/audit/evidence/adni_rank_selection.csv`), requiring every component's out-of-bag `latent_reliability_gain` ($\mathrm{ICC}(1) - \text{baseline}$) to clear 0.2, non-decreasing multivariate reliability gain, and `all_coupled = True`. Under `positivity="positive"`, `select_rank` selects $k =$ 2: at $k = 2$, component reliabilities are 0.891 and 0.975 (gains 0.438 and 0.630, multivariate reliability 0.945, gain 0.520, `all_coupled =` True); at $k = 3$, Component 2 drops to 0.502 (gain 0.219), multivariate gain falls to 0.402 (failing multivariate monotonicity), and `all_coupled =` False (`passed =` False). Under signed estimation (`positivity="either"`), `select_rank` also selects $k =$ 2: at $k = 2$, component reliabilities are 0.697 and 0.603 (gains 0.478 and 0.432, multivariate reliability 0.651, gain 0.456, `all_coupled =` True), whereas at $k = 3$ Component 3 drops to 0.197 (gain -0.053, `passed =` False).

## Preprocessing Controls: Subject Row-Mean Removal, ICA Initialization, and Orthogonal Varimax Rotation

On neuroimaging cohorts where cortical regions share a positive global correlation floor, @tbl-app-rowmean-ica and @fig-rowmean-k-ablation compare column centering with in-fold subject row-mean centering, PCA with deterministic FastICA [@hyvarinen2000independent] initialization, signed with non-negative bases, and the initializer alone with the fitted model (`SiMLR`, $k = 3$, $w = 0.50$, no Varimax, no quantile threshold; `scripts/paper_adni_ablations.py`). Row-mean centering applies to the three MRI views only; the eleven cognitive scales are on different units, and subtracting each subject's mean across them would remove overall severity from the outcome. With non-negative bases, row-mean centering changes structural MRI sparsity from 92% to 56% and `CogPC1` $R^2$ from 0.208 to 0.150 with PCA initialization (and to 54% sparsity and 0.171 `CogPC1` $R^2$ with ICA initialization). Varimax rotation on column-centered data gives 67% sparsity on the 62 DKT regions with [2, 0, 60] active regions per component, against 67% and [60, 2, 0] without rotation.

## Computational Complexity Summary

| Operation | Complexity per Iteration | Memory Footprint | Inner-Loop Factorization Required? |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `nsa_flow` Retraction Step | $\mathcal{O}(p_m k^2)$ | $\mathcal{O}(p_m k + k^2)$ | None (1 Gram product + 2 $[p_m,k]\times[k,k]$ products) |
| Polar Consensus Update ($\mathbf{U}$) | $\mathcal{O}(N k^2 + k^3)$ | $\mathcal{O}(N k)$ | $k \times k$ Sylvester polar factor ($k \ll N$) |
| Forward / Backward Pass | $\mathcal{O}(N p_m k)$ | $\mathcal{O}(N k + p_m k)$ | None |

: Computational and memory complexity of the `SiMR` and `nsa_flow` primitives. {#tbl-app-complexity}
